cloud.reading: Reading Orchester Cloud and your team servers…

list.signInFor: Sign in for invites and your servers

line.noProjects: No project on this computer yet
line.certificateChanged: Nothing sent until you check it

none.title: No team servers yet
none.body: Accept an invite, or connect a server by its address. Projects you share live on a server your team runs.

list.note: Orchester Cloud keeps your account and invites; your projects never pass through it. This computer connects to each team server once, and each project you link uses that connection.
list.serverNote: Members, invites and devices of a team server are managed in its server admin, in the browser. Orchester keeps your connection and your projects' links.

tabs.devicesNotBuilt: Your Orchester Cloud devices aren't in this version of the app yet

account.nameValue: {{name}} · shown on your invites and to teammates
account.signingOutText: Sign out ends this computer's session with Orchester Cloud: invites stop arriving here. Team servers you joined keep working, each with its own sign-in for this computer; sign out of each one on the left.

tokenNote.windows: The cloud token for this computer is kept in Windows Credential Manager. Orchester never shows it.
tokenNote.macos: The cloud token for this computer is kept in your login Keychain. Orchester never shows it.

invites.title: Waiting invites
invites.lead: Invites to projects and servers reach you here and by email. Accepting connects this computer to the server and opens the project's join review; nothing is uploaded before you confirm there.
invites.notOffered: This Orchester Cloud doesn't deliver invites yet. An invite by email can't reach you here until it does; an invite code still works: Connect a server.
invites.toAccount: {{inviter}} invited you to link your Orchester account on {{server}}

stopped.title: Stopped connecting
stopped.body: If the server had already let this computer in, it shows under Team servers. Otherwise accept the invite again.

invites.declineBody: The invite ends. {{inviter}} sees it was declined; nothing else is told.
invites.connecting: Connecting to {{server}}… its certificate comes with the invite, so there's nothing to compare.

joined.title: Connected to {{server}}
joined.project: {{project}} is next: link its checkout from that project's Project settings › Sharing.
joined.server: You're on the server. When someone adds you to a project, it's offered here to link a checkout.

approval.title: Waiting for approval
approval.body: {{server}} asks for approval of new computers. Approve this one in Orchester on another computer of yours, or ask an admin of {{server}}. Nothing has been uploaded.

invites.ended: This invite has ended: it expired or was revoked. Ask for a new one; nothing was connected.

signIn.title: Sign in to Orchester Cloud
signIn.lead: Your Orchester account brings invites to this computer and, on a new computer, finds the team servers you joined. Use the email and password of your account.
signIn.webHint: Create an account and Forgot password open {{host}} in your browser. Confirm your email there, then sign in here.

unconfirmed.title: Confirm your email first
unconfirmed.body: Open the link Orchester Cloud sent to {{email}}, then sign in here. No email? Ask for a new one on the cloud's page.

paused.title: Too many attempts
paused.body: Sign-in for this email is paused. Try again in {{minutes}} min.

unreachable.title: Orchester Cloud can't be reached
unreachable.body: Team servers you joined keep working without it. A server on a closed network takes an invite code.

opened.title: Opened in your browser
opened.body: {{page}}. Confirm your email there, then sign in here.

signIn.openFailed: {{page}} couldn't be opened: Orchester opens only https pages in the browser.

offline.title: No internet where your server runs?
offline.body: A team server on a closed network takes its address and an 8-character invite code instead of an account. Ask whoever runs it for both.
offline.connect: Connect a server with a code

advanced.title: Advanced · cloud address
advanced.label: Orchester Cloud address
advanced.hint: For a test cloud. Changing it signs you out of Orchester Cloud; team servers you joined keep working.

testCloud.title: Using a test cloud
testCloud.body: Invites and servers from {{host}} don't show here while it's set.

facts.nobody: Not signed in from this computer
facts.computerValue: Orchester on {{computer}} · signed in until unused for 90 days
facts.system: Trusted by your system: a public or your team's own authority issued it
facts.plain: None: plain HTTP, to this computer or allowed for this server

projects.title: Projects on this computer
projects.none: You aren't a member of a project there yet.
projects.explanation: Each project is linked to one checkout on this computer. A project of yours without a checkout here: clone it yourself, add the folder in All projects, then link it in its Project settings › Sharing.
projects.signedOut: Join again to read your projects there; the ones linked here are listed below.
projects.offline: {{server}} can't be reached, so your projects there can't be read now. The ones linked on this computer are listed below.
projects.offlineNoneHere: {{server}} can't be reached, so your projects there can't be read now. None of them is linked on this computer.
projects.signedOutNoneHere: Join again to read your projects there. None of them is linked on this computer.
projects.linkLater: Linking from here isn't in this version of the app yet: clone the project yourself, add the folder in All projects, then link it in its Project settings › Sharing.

computers.title: Your other computers
computers.body: Joining {{server}} from another computer of yours: with Orchester Cloud, signing in there is enough. Without it, make a pairing code here and enter it there with {{server}}'s address.

admin.title: Server admin
admin.bodyAdmin: Projects, members and roles, invites, people, devices and {{server}}'s settings are managed in the browser, at {{url}}. You're an admin there; members see only the link.
admin.bodyMember: Members and roles, invites and devices of {{server}} are managed in the browser by its admins and owners, at {{url}}.
admin.hint: Makes a pairing code that signs you in to the server admin once, within 10 minutes: for when your browser can't reach Orchester Cloud.
admin.openFailed: {{url}} couldn't be opened: Orchester opens only https pages in the browser.

signOutQuestion.title: Sign out of {{server}} on this computer?
signOutQuestion.projects: {{projects}} stop sending and receiving. Their tasks stay here as they are now, and the changes you make wait on this computer until you connect again.
signOutQuestion.noProjects: No project on this computer is linked to it.
signOutQuestion.forgets: {{server}} forgets this computer; your account and your projects there stay. Join again with Orchester Cloud or a code.
signOutQuestion.project: {{projects}} stops sending and receiving. Its tasks stay here as they are now, and the changes you make wait on this computer until you connect again.

certificate.title: {{server}} presents a different certificate
certificate.body: Its admin may have replaced it, or something is between you and the server. Until you check, {{projects}} sends and receives nothing; your changes wait here.
certificate.bodyNoProjects: Its admin may have replaced it, or something is between you and the server. Until you check, nothing is sent to it.
certificate.reading: Reading the certificate it presents now…
certificate.compare: Compare it with the code the server prints at its start, or with Server admin › Settings › Certificate, shown to you by its admin. Was {{was}}.
certificate.person: Only you can answer this; agents and Orchester's MCP tools can't.

signedOut.title: This computer's sign-in on {{server}} ended
signedOut.body: It went unused for 90 days, or someone revoked it in the server admin. Your waiting changes are kept here.
signedOut.waiting: Waiting for approval: approve this computer on another computer of yours, or ask an admin.
signedOut.byYouTitle: Not signed in to {{server}} on this computer
signedOut.byYouBody: You signed out of it here; your account and your projects there stay. Join again to work on them from this computer.

tokenNote.windows: This computer's token for {{server}} is kept in Windows Credential Manager. Orchester never shows it; Sign out deletes it.
tokenNote.macos: This computer's token for {{server}} is kept in your login Keychain. Orchester never shows it; Sign out deletes it.
tokenNote.refused: {{server}} no longer accepts this computer's token. Joining again replaces it.
tokenNote.noneWindows: This computer holds no token for {{server}}: signing out deleted it from Windows Credential Manager. Joining again stores a new one.
tokenNote.noneMacos: This computer holds no token for {{server}}: signing out deleted it from your login Keychain. Joining again stores a new one.

pairing.title: Pairing code for {{server}}
pairing.computer: On your other computer: Connect a server, {{host}}, the check code, then this code. It works once, within 10 minutes, as {{username}}.
pairing.admin: In your browser, at {{host}}/admin › Sign in with a code, enter it there. It works once, within 10 minutes, as {{username}}.
pairing.once: Shown once: Orchester doesn't keep it.

errors.local: Something on this computer failed; the log says what.
errors.address: The Orchester Cloud address isn't an address. Fix it in Advanced · cloud address.
errors.signedOut: You aren't signed in to Orchester Cloud on this computer.
errors.notOffered: This Orchester Cloud doesn't offer that yet. A server takes an invite code instead.
errors.noServer: Orchester Cloud doesn't know a server of yours at that address.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
errors.busy: Orchester Cloud is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.keys: Orchester Cloud can't sign right now. Try again later.
errors.certificate: Your system doesn't trust Orchester Cloud's certificate.
errors.serverSignedOut: This computer's sign-in on the server ended.
errors.serverUnreachable: The server can't be reached. Check that this computer is on its network.
errors.certificateChanged: The server presents a different certificate; nothing was sent to it.
errors.tooManyCodes: The server holds as many open codes as it allows. Try again once one is used or expires.

notice.manyBody: Invites to projects and servers, through Orchester Cloud.
